subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II access window for FinServ Q1-2028 audit
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@auditfirm.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Charlotte Wells <charlotte@finservcorp.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II access window for FinServ Q1-2028 audit

Hi Grace / Ben,

We are kicking off FinServ Corp's routine SOC 2 Type II review next month and would like to schedule access to Redwood's SOC 2 report and supporting evidence. Two asks:

1) Can you provide a full copy of the SOC 2 Type II report for 2027 and a bridge letter if the audit period does not cover through the client cutoff of 2028-03-31?
2) For evidence review, the auditors prefer a single downloadable bundle (ZIP) containing the selected artifacts (system configs, policies, sample logs). Please confirm whether you can provision a one-time downloadable ZIP from your trust portal, the maximum window the link can be active, and whether IP allowlisting is required for downloads.

Target timeline from FinServ: evidence access between 2028-03-25 and 2028-04-01 (flexible). Let us know your preferred two-hour window so we can coordinate with the engagement team. Also please confirm who (auditor emails) should be granted access.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Senior Manager, Audit Operations
ClearLake Audit Partners

--
attachment: scope_of_request.pdf (PDF stub)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@auditfirm.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access window for FinServ Q1-2028 audit

Emma — thanks for the clear summary. We can support both items. Planned approach below: 

- SOC 2 report: We will attach the Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf and can also provide a short bridge letter if the auditor requires explicit coverage through 2028-03-31. I attached a draft bridge letter (preliminary_bridge_letter_draft.docx) for review.

- Evidence bundle: We can generate a curated evidence bundle as a single ZIP (evidence_bundle_Q1-2028.zip) and host it behind our Trust Portal as a one-time download link. Security controls we enforce on the link: mandatory Okta SSO (auditors must use their verified email), link expires at a configured timestamp, download is one-time (file removed after successful download), and we emit an audit export (download event, IP, user). IP allowlist is optional but supported — if FinServ requires it, send the IP ranges.

- Proposed window: we can create a 2-hour scheduled window on 2028-03-28 from 14:00–16:00 UTC (09:00–11:00 PT). If that doesn't work, propose an alternate 2-hour slot.

Please confirm: (a) auditor emails to grant access to; (b) whether IP allowlisting is required (and IP ranges); and (c) whether you want the bridge letter signed by our Head of Trust (we can sign after you confirm wording).

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (list of files we intend to include), preliminary_bridge_letter_draft.docx (draft)

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-20T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access window for FinServ Q1-2028 audit

Neha — looping you in for approval on the one-time ZIP workflow. A few operational notes: 

- We will assemble the ZIP from the curated manifest (evidence_manifest.csv). Suggest we exclude full raw PII logs; include redacted samples and logs with sample IDs.
- Recommend we use a pre-signed S3 object with a single-download token (server-side enforcement) and enable session-level logging.
- Need guidance on retention after download: keep a copy for 30 days in an internal audit bucket, then purge.

If approved, I'll queue the job for 2028-03-28 14:00 UTC. Approve/adjust?

Ben
Senior Security Engineer
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-20T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access window for FinServ Q1-2028 audit

Ben — approve the proposed process. Keep the internal retention to 30 days and ensure the audit export includes: timestamp, downloader email, IP, file checksum, and Request-ID (audit_access_ticket). Ben — please also include audit_scope.txt in the ZIP to document what was provided.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security Operations
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@auditfirm.com>, Charlotte Wells <charlotte@finservcorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Final: SOC 2 access window + one-time download link (FinServ audit)

Emma / Charlotte — thanks for the coordination. Confirming final schedule and access details below: 

Scheduled window: 2028-03-28 14:00–16:00 UTC
One-time download link: https://trust.redwood.ai/one-time/AB12CD34
Link expires: 2028-04-01T02:00:00Z (server will revoke earlier if download completes)
Audit access ticket: AUD-20280322-7921

Included in ZIP (attached):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (PDF)
- evidence_bundle_Q1-2028.zip (ZIP) — curated artifacts (see evidence_manifest.csv)
- evidence_manifest.csv (CSV)
- audit_scope.txt (TXT)
- preliminary_bridge_letter_draft.docx (DOCX) — please review and confirm any edits; Head of Trust will sign once confirmed.

Security notes:
- Okta SSO enforcement on the link; auditors must authenticate with the email addresses we have on file.
- IP allowlisting: not required by default; if FinServ needs it, send ranges before 2028-03-26 and we will apply.
- Download audit export will be provided within 24 hours of the event.

Action items for you: please confirm the list of auditor emails who will use the link and whether IP allowlisting is requested. Once you confirm, Ben will schedule the ZIP generation job and I will sign the bridge letter post-review.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
